package_info.why_malicious: The package is not intentionally malicious, but contains a vulnerability (CVE-2020-7599) that causes sensitive pre-signed AWS URLs to be logged at certain log levels. If these logs are exposed (e.g., in public CI systems), attackers can use the leaked URLs to overwrite recently uploaded plugins with malicious artifacts.

execution_context.file_location: Gradle build log (when run with --info or lower log level)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Publishing plugin to AWS S3 using pre-signed URL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/gradle-plugins/....?AWSAccessKeyId=...&Expires=...&Signature=...
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At build-time, the plugin logs a sensitive pre-signed AWS S3 upload URL to the build log if the log level is set to --info or lower, potentially exposing the URL to anyone with access to the logs.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Logging sensitive upload URLs exposes them to anyone with access to the logs, which can be especially dangerous if logs are public (e.g., in CI/CD systems).
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normally, sensitive credentials or URLs should never be logged, especially not at non-debug log levels. The actual behavior leaks a credential that can be used to overwrite published plugins.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Logging URLs for debugging purposes in a secure, private environment.
key_indicators: Sensitive pre-signed AWS S3 URL appears in logs
Log level is set to --info or lower
URL can be used to overwrite published artifacts

attack_chain.action: Plugin author publishes a plugin using the vulnerable plugin-publish plugin; a pre-signed AWS S3 URL is generated and logged at --info or lower log level.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive URL is exposed in build logs.

attack_chain.action: Attacker discovers the exposed pre-signed URL in public CI logs.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains access to the upload endpoint.

attack_chain.action: Attacker uses the pre-signed URL to overwrite the recently uploaded plugin with a malicious artifact within the URL's validity window.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious plugin is distributed to users.

behavioral_signatures: Logging of pre-signed AWS S3 URLs during plugin publishing
Sensitive credential or URL exposure in build logs
Unusual artifact overwrites shortly after initial upload
file_indicators: Gradle build logs containing 'AWSAccessKeyId' or 'Signature' parameters
Logs with full S3 pre-signed URLs
network_indicators: S3 upload requests using pre-signed URLs found in logs
Unexpected S3 PUT requests shortly after plugin publication
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor build logs for the presence of pre-signed AWS S3 URLs, especially those containing 'AWSAccessKeyId' and 'Signature' parameters. Alert if such URLs are logged at info or lower log levels. Monitor for S3 PUT requests using these URLs shortly after plugin publication, and flag any artifact overwrites that occur within the URL's validity window.
